Definition: from G1844; one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer):--exorcist.
BiblicalUsage: exorkistḗs is the word for exorcist. In Acts 19:13, the text says "exorcists."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of exorkistḗs I do not force more than it gives: exorcist.
RelatedEvents: The Sons of Sceva at Ephesus
